card.band: 8h. Frontier gets non-ignorable ordering quickly, then fails on contractions, discontiguous matches and shifted weighting. A weaker model stops at the simple per-codepoint lookup. Buckets: variants, implicit weights, contractions, tailorings.
card.cheat: The expected order is not shipped as a table. Hidden pairs are generated, and sorting by code point or a lookup of the public file does not pass them. The oracle crate is held in the verifier.
card.grading: Hidden cases include the 848k CollationTest lines (4 variants) plus generated string pairs and tailoring cases. The oracle is icu_collator, used in the verifier only, compared on the sign of the comparison. Exact; score is the fraction passed per variant and tailoring bucket.
card.reference: We write a Rust implementation (about 2000 lines) and check it against the icu_collator oracle on all cases to confirm it scores 1.
card.task: /app ships allkeys.txt (DUCET), UCD files and a library skeleton. The agent implements sort keys and compare for UTS #10: contraction and expansion matching, discontiguous contractions, implicit weights for Han, Tangut and unified ideographs, variable weighting (non-ignorable and shifted), and normalization pre-pass. It also supports a small set of CLDR-style tailorings given as rule strings.
card.title: UCA collation key generator with DUCET and tailoring

history: icu_collator 2.3.1 has no rule-string tailoring API (only compiled locale data), so tailoring buckets have no oracle; icu_collator uses CLDR root, not DUCET; no DUCET-only mode; feruca 0.12.0 DUCET fails 883 of 212035 adjacent pairs on the 18.0.0 NON_IGNORABLE file, so it is not a clean second basel
source_notes: ordering test: verifier checks monotonic sort order, so output is sort keys or compare function; implicit weights for Han/Tangut and variable weighting (shifted vs non-ignorable) are the tricky parts; low crowding; huge case count but one algorithm

blockers: icu_collator 2.3.1 has no rule-string tailoring API (only compiled locale data), so tailoring buckets have no oracle
icu_collator uses CLDR root, not DUCET; no DUCET-only mode

spike.headroom_note: The untouched start (library skeleton only) was not run. The reference is not written. The 848,304-line count holds (4 files x 212,076).
spike.notes: The idea fails the spike's pass_if (the spike_plan's kill_if names K5 for the tailoring buckets). Downloads: allkeys.txt is version 18.0.0, CollationTest has 4 files of 212,076 lines each (848,304 total). The harness checks that adjacent lines are non-decreasing (212,035 pairs per file). Failed pairs: icu_collator 638 (NON_IGNORABLE) and 851 (SHIFTED); feruca 0.12.0 DUCET 883 and 823; feruca CLDR root 879 and 1089. icu_collator therefore passes about 99.6-99.7% of pairs, but it is CLDR root, not DUCET, and it has no way to take a rule string like '&a < g'. A fix that would work: the reference would be our own Rust implementation checked against the CollationTest files, with the tailoring oracle limited to a hand-built tailoring (for example our own implementation, or ICU4C if added). That is a redesign, not a spike pass. Repeated icu runs gave identical output (determinism OK). The ICU path is a pure library call, so offline_ok is true after vendoring. Nothing here needs perf counters, valgrind or Landlock.

facts.claim: UCA 'latest' directory lists version 18.0.0 data with CollationTest.zip (4.6M), allkeys.txt (2.2M), ctt.txt and decomps.txt
ReadMe in UCA latest says 'final data files for version 18.0.0 of UTS #10: Unicode Collation Algorithm'
UTS #10 is at revision 55, Version 18.0.0, dated 2026-08-31, synchronized with Unicode 18.0
CollationTest files exist as NON_IGNORABLE and SHIFTED (plus _SHORT), test untailored DUCET order, and CLDR variants use the same names with a _CLDR infix
Each CollationTest line is ordered >= the previous line under UCA at identical strength, so the test is an adjacent-pair monotonicity check; sort keys in comments are informational
CollationTest files for 18.0.0 are published at the latest path; the latest CollationTest.html page returned 404 on fetch
The CollationTest suites total 848k lines across 4 variants
icu_collator (ICU4X) repository licence is Unicode License v3 (SPDX Unicode-3.0)
icu_collator crate page reports its own licence field, version and repository
icu_collator does not pass or claim CollationTest conformance in its published docs or README
icu_collator documents known deviations from ICU4C: unpaired surrogates sort as REPLACEMENT CHARACTER so they compare equal; no backward iteration
icu_collator accepts arbitrary CLDR-style tailoring rule strings at runtime (oracle could produce tailoring expectations from rule strings)
icu_collator can produce an untailored DUCET-only order (not CLDR root) for the two DUCET CollationTest variants
feruca 0.8.0 is an MIT-licensed Rust implementation of UCA that passes the official conformance tests, supports non-ignorable and shifted, and CLDR root
Tangut, Nushu and Khitan implicit weights are specified in UTS #10 section 10.1.3
Seed reference (~2000-line Rust implementation scoring exactly 1 against icu_collator) exists

full_card.band: 8h tier. Claimed frontier success on untailored orders, then failure on contractions, discontiguous matches, shifted weighting and tailorings. No dated public evidence yet.
full_card.build_cost: About 2-4 days: 2000-line reference, oracle harness with DUCET and CLDR variants, tailoring cases, surrogate filtering. Under the 5-day limit.
full_card.deliverable: Rust library: sort-key generation and compare for UCA 18.0.0 with normalization pre-pass, variable weighting (non-ignorable, shifted), implicit weights, contractions/expansions/discontiguous matches, and rule-string tailorings.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Hidden pairs and tailorings generated in verifier; expected order not shipped; oracle held in verifier; sorting by code point or table lookup fails. Open: surrogate lines must be filtered; oracle DUCET mode and tailoring support unverified.
full_card.grading_surface: CollationTest lines (4 variants, count 848k claimed, not verified) plus generated string pairs and tailoring buckets; sign-of-comparison exact per bucket.
full_card.local_fit: Rust CPU-only, small data, deterministic; fits 8 CPU / 16 GB sandbox.
full_card.lookup: direct: feruca (MIT, Rust, passes conformance) and icu_collator (Unicode-3.0) are public complete UCA-family implementations; not installable offline; agents may recall UCA structure from ICU/pyuca in outline.
full_card.provenance: UTS #10 / UCA 18.0.0 data (allkeys.txt, CollationTest.zip) from unicode.org; UTS #10 revision 55 dated 2026-08-31. Public, pinned version confirmed.
full_card.reference: Not yet written. Plan: CG Rust implementation ~2000 lines checked against icu_collator (Unicode-3.0). Public alternatives: icu_collator and feruca (MIT); not shipped.
full_card.ships: /app: allkeys.txt (DUCET), UCD files, library skeleton. Not shipped: CollationTest files, CLDR root table (needed for CLDR variants, not in seed list), icu_collator, reference.
full_card.similarity: Nearest l0 neighbour S-im-044 at 0.322 (same batch, different subject per title); S-im-037 0.17, S-im-038 0.161; no CROWDED entry for UCA; no K1.

Band.why: Band claim is plausible but has no dated public evidence; a frontier agent may reach DUCET variants quickly, so tailorings are the main difficulty.

Build.why: Estimated 2-4 days including the oracle harness and tailoring support; under the 5-day limit.

Fit.why: CPU-only Rust library and small data; fits the sandbox.

Hor.why: 8h tier with several levers (variants, implicit weights, contractions, tailorings) gives sustained work.

Lic.why: Unicode License v3 (Unicode-3.0) confirmed for icu4x; UCA data is under Unicode terms, shippable.

Multi.why: Four CollationTest variants plus tailoring and implicit-weight buckets give steady partial credit.

Nov.why: No CROWDED match; nearest neighbour 0.322 is S-im-044 in the same batch, which is below near-duplicate.

Real.why: Pinned UCA 18.0.0 data and UTS #10 revision 55 confirmed at unicode.org.

Ref.why: Reference not written. Oracle DUCET-only mode and rule-string tailoring are unverified, so scoring 1 on all buckets is unproven.

Seal.why: Oracle and reference are public (icu_collator, feruca) and are not shipped; UCA is well known, so recall is a Band issue, not Seal.

Surf.why: CollationTest line files are public and large, but the 848k count is unverified and tailoring cases are generated.

spike_plan.kill_if: Oracle cannot produce DUCET-only order or cannot take rule-string tailorings (then kill K5 for tailoring buckets), or its pass rate on 18.0.0 files is well below 99% after surrogate filtering.
spike_plan.pass_if: Oracle passes at least 99% of non-surrogate lines for both DUCET variants, has a DUCET-only mode or a documented way to get it, and produces a tailored order from a rule string.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, download https://www.unicode.org/Public/UCA/latest/CollationTest.zip and allkeys.txt; unzip into a fresh directory and record file line counts for NON_IGNORABLE, SHIFTED and _SHORT. Check whether the 848k total holds.

Add icu_collator to a scratch Cargo project. Confirm the crate version and its CLDR/UCA data version. Check whether it offers a DUCET-only (non-CLDR) root, and whether it accepts a rule-string tailoring such as '&a < g'.
Run icu_collator as a monotonicity check over the NON_IGNORABLE and SHIFTED CollationTest files, filtering lines with unpaired surrogates. Report the pass rate.
Run feruca 0.8.0 over the same files as a second, independent baseline, to confirm the 18.0.0 files are attainable by a public implementation.
Run icu_collator twice on the same generated pairs to check determinism. Record outputs in the scratch directory.

v1.summary: The seed is real and sealable: UCA 18.0.0 data and CollationTest files are confirmed at unicode.org, and icu4x is Unicode-3.0. It is not killed, but it is conditional: the 848k count and the oracle's DUCET and rule-string tailoring support are unverified, and the spike must confirm them before the reference is built.

v2.note: UCA 18.0.0 data and UTS #10 rev 55 are confirmed. CollationTest checks adjacent lines for order, so it works as its own oracle for the DUCET non-ignorable and shifted variants. feruca (MIT) shows those files can be passed. Main risk is the oracle. icu_collator is CLDR-root and its DUCET-only mode is unverified, and it probably cannot take runtime rule strings. The tailoring bucket needs ICU4C RuleBasedCollator in the verifier; confirm this in the spike, or drop tailoring and lean on contraction, implicit-weight and generated-pair buckets. Untailored UCA is well known, so the tailoring-rule parser has to carry most of the depth. Without it this is K8. The 848k case count is unverified, and surrogate lines must be filtered.
